entities.name: Q04772 Increased recombination centers protein 21
observations: Exact 201-aa sequence match to reviewed Saccharomyces cerevisiae UniProt Q04772; molecular weight 23,181.6 Da and predicted pI 9.53.
UniProt annotation reports involvement in resistance to carboplatin and cisplatin and a probable role in a pathway contributing to genomic integrity.
Annotated to cytoplasm, DNA damage response, xenobiotic response, NAD(P)H-dependent cytochrome-b5 reductase activity, and heme binding.
Pfam detects a Cyt-b5 domain (PF00173.34) at residues 128–199; domain evidence supports heme-associated cytochrome-b5-like function.
